text: DSH Marketplace（DSH 插件，Web 面板、Desktop profile、agent 工具与 CLI）：为 DeepSeek Harness 提供精选与社区插件市场。它在 DSH 侧栏提供市场、已装和设置视图，并注册插件搜索及管理工具。用户可以按分类浏览或跨目录搜索插件，查看详情与安装信息，管理已安装插件的升级、开关和卸载，也可通过 dshm 命令行查询和操作。适合希望在一个界面发现并维护 DSH 插件的用户；不需要额外 API Key 或市场账号，使用本机 DSH profile。

DSH Marketplace adds a sidebar, agent tools, and CLI to browse curated and community plugins. Search by keyword or category, view details, and install, update, toggle, or remove plugins. It supports Desktop profiles and requires no separate API key or marketplace account.
想在 DSH 里搜索社区插件和精选插件。
我想按分类找一个能安装的 DSH 插件。
能不能查看本机 DSH 当前装了哪些插件？
我想从一个面板里更新或停用 DSH 插件。
有没有办法用命令行查看和管理 DSH 插件？
I want to browse and search plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
How can I see which plugins are installed in my DSH profile?
I need one place to install, update, toggle, and remove DSH plugins.
DSH Marketplace 的功能「分区浏览与跨区搜索」：侧栏将社区、精选和收藏分开展示；搜索可同时匹配两个目录，并支持分类筛选与分页浏览。
DSH Marketplace 的功能「插件详情与安装」：用户可从市场条目进入详情并发起安装，安装完成后刷新市场与已装插件视图。
DSH Marketplace 的功能「已装插件管理」：已装视图展示插件来源和版本，提供升级、开关、卸载及逐项汇总的全部更新操作。
DSH Marketplace 的功能「对话内插件工具」：注册搜索、列出、安装、切换、卸载、检查更新、升级和重启工具，供 agent 在对话中调用。
DSH Marketplace 的功能「市场设置」：可调整精选清单地址、请求超时与缓存时长，也可启停社区目录并锁定其版本。
DSH Marketplace 的功能「dshm 命令行」：CLI 支持搜索、列出已装插件、查看更新，并安装、升级、切换或卸载条目。

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_search：Search the DSH plugin marketplace (dsh-m) and show clickable plugin cards. ALWAYS call this instead of web_search or bash when the user wants to find/recommend/browse DSH plugins (插件). Call EXACTLY ONCE per user message; extract a real keyword (主题, 搜索) rather than pasting the whole sentence. Dual catalog: ~23 hand-curated 精选 entries plus a 6,000+ community catalog — default searches all; pass source="community" or "primary" to zone in. Returns 10 cards by default; use offset (take nextOffset from the result) for more batches. Cards may carry audience="internal" (作者自用; do not proactively recommend to general users unless the user names one or asks about internal rollout) and decoupled=true (版本无关, survives DSH upgrades without per-release adaptation). After cards appear, reply with AT MOST one short sentence. Do not print install commands.

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_list：List plugins installed in the current DSH profile (web or desktop), annotated with 市场安装/非市场安装, sources, and outdated flags. Use when the user asks what plugins are installed or wants to manage local plugins.

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_install：Install a plugin from the dsh-m registry into the current web profile after the user names one (装 dsh-skins / 安装 web-search). Pass the id from dshm_search results. npm 源锁定最新精确版本，github 源锁定 commit SHA。安装前做 peer 兼容预检（只检 @deepseek-ai/dsh(-*)；github 源不预检）：不兼容时返回结构化结果，向用户说明风险，用户确认后带 force: true 重试（force 等价 forceIncompatible）。Do not print CLI commands. After success, tell the user it needs a restart of dsh web, and offer dshm_restart. A needsBuildApproval result is an abort, not success: after the user confirms, retry dshm_install with approvedBuilds echoing the returned pendingBuilds verbatim; never claim the install succeeded.

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_toggle：Toggle a DSH plugin on/off (切换运行状态). Pass pkg from dshm_list and enabled (true=启用 / false=停用). 可逆操作：默认先与用户确认；用户同一句消息已明确表达（如「把 skins 关掉」）可直接执行。结果 applied=live 时告知已即时生效；restart-required 时提示需重启并提供 dshm_restart。受保护插件（dsh-m 自身与官方宿主命脉）会被拒绝。

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_uninstall：Uninstall a DSH plugin from the current DSH profile by package name (pkg from dshm_list). Confirm with the user BEFORE calling. Does not delete plugin data; reports leftover paths instead.
dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_outdated：Check installed DSH plugins for newer versions (npm latest / GitHub HEAD). Use when the user asks about updates or 升级. Read-only.

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_upgrade：Upgrade an installed DSH plugin to the latest version (npm 拉最新精确版 / github 重新锁 HEAD)。pkg 来自 dshm_list 或 dshm_outdated。用户确认升级哪一个之后再调用。After success follow the result's activation field: 'client-only' → tell the user a page refresh suffices and do NOT offer dshm_restart; 'unknown' or 'restart-required' (or the field being absent) → tell the user it needs a restart and offer dshm_restart. A needsBuildApproval result is an abort, not success: after the user confirms, retry dshm_upgrade with approvedBuilds echoing the returned pendingBuilds verbatim; never claim the upgrade succeeded.

dsh-m 提供工具 dshm_restart：Restart DSH web so newly installed/uninstalled/upgraded plugins take effect. ONLY call after the user agrees (用户同意重启后). DSH Web reconnects in the background after the service comes back.

dsh-m README · 30 秒上手：在 DSH 官方「插件管理 → 添加插件」中输入 `dsh-m`，选择可用的安装源并安装。**Web 重启服务并刷新页面；Desktop 退出并重新打开应用**。随后从侧栏底部进入「插件市场」。

无图形界面的 Web 宿主也可执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-m`。Node.js 需 ≥ 22.19.0；支持的 DSH 代际见[兼容表](#兼容与常见问题)。`npm install -g dsh-m` **仅安装独立 `dshm` CLI**，不会把市场插件注册到 DSH profile。

> 官方插件管理界面的就地更新能力以宿主版本和界面提示为准；如果明确提示不支持，请按提示卸载旧版后重新安装。卸载不会自动清除插件数据。

dsh-m README · 浏览、搜索与安装：- **社区 + 精选**：社区目录默认开启，收录 6,000+ 个条目（随上游目录持续增长，实际以面板计数为准）；精选清单按「装机必备 / 崔添翼精选 / iasi自研 / 腾讯轻量云专区 / 观察区」策展。重名条目以精选为准：跨区搜索只呈现精选版本，社区浏览则会保留这类条目并以「精选」徽章标注。
- **分区浏览、全局搜索**：分类、排序（社区区可按下载量 / Stars / 收录日期）和分页在各区独立保留；输入中文或英文关键词时，同时搜索社区与精选，并分别展示命中数。收藏保存在浏览器本地（localStorage），不进 profile、不上服务端。
- **安装前先看详情**：卡片显示来源、安装状态与版本，图标优先取目录或包内声明、缺失时回退 GitHub 头像；详情展示说明、兼容信息和可用的安装入口。「作者自用」「版本无关」等徽章是受众与适配提示，不代表安全或质量背书。npm 包锁定**精确版本并校验 integrity**，GitHub 来源锁定 **commit SHA**；peer 不兼容时先提示风险，未经确认不强行安装。

> **社区收录不是安全审查。** 6,000+ 条目录来源广泛，安装前请核对作者、代码与所需能力；能力字段缺失表示「未扫描」，不表示「未发现风险」。

dsh-m README · 已装插件与设置：「**已装**」只反映当前宿主 profile 的实际插件：区分市场/非市场来源，显示运行相位与可用更新，并提供开关、升级、「全部更新」和确认后卸载——批量更新逐项串行执行、遇真实失败即停，dsh-m 自身固定最后升级。相关操作进度与结果会统一记录。开关可能即时生效或需要重启，应以操作结果为准。卸载只移除插件引用，不会默默删除用户数据，疑似残留路径会单独报告。

「**设置**」可查看社区目录的版本、获取线路和缓存状态，开关或锁定社区目录版本；也可下载默认精选清单、填入自定义地址并**校验后整体替换精选区**（社区区不变）。校验失败不改当前生效配置；恢复默认或成功应用均无需重启。

dsh-m README · 已装插件与设置：自定义地址支持 HTTPS、本机绝对路径或 `file://`（HTTP 仅限 loopback 调试），清单大小 ≤ 2 MiB、条目 ≤ 1,000。自定义源是独立快照，**不会自动同步默认精选**；源失效时保留该源最近的成功缓存，不会暗中切回默认。添加精选条目或了解完整校验规则，请看 [清单文案指南](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/registry-copy-guide.md)与[设计文档](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md)。

dsh-m README · Agent 工具与 CLI：GUI 与 Agent 工具始终跟随**当前宿主 profile**（Web / Desktop）；独立 CLI 则操作 web profile，唯一例外是只读体检 `dshm doctor --profile desktop`，其余命令的 `--profile desktop` 会被拒绝——Desktop 插件管理走官方插件管理页。`--force` 可在用户已确认 peer 不兼容风险后用于安装或升级。`registry`、`search`、`outdated` 在清单不可用时明确失败，`list` 仍可列已装插件。完整参数与运行策略见[设计文档](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md)。

| `0.2.1-rc.3` | 同 0.2.0 通路 | 最后完整实测于 dsh-m 0.10.11（link 装机：测试 1719/1719 零失败 + 七项兼容清单）；后续版本未复测 |
| `0.2.1-rc.4` | 同 0.2.0 通路 | 0.11.x 线 dogfood 宿主（本机 web 档 dsh-m 0.11.0 常驻运行）；0.11.1 发版（全量测试 1841/1841 + 发版门禁全绿）；官方契约核对取自 rc.3/rc.4 双版（ADR-0027） |
| `0.2.1-rc.5` | 同 0.2.0 通路 | 契约面等价重发布（宿主 web-app patch 相对 rc.4 零 diff）；rc.4 的核验结论按等价口径承接；0.11.x 线 dogfood 宿主已随宿主升级运行于 rc.5 |
| `0.2.2-rc.1` | 同 0.2.0 通路 | 新 minor 线首轮（宿主 web-app patch 含 UI bundle 行增删，非等价重发布）；0.12.x 线 dogfood 宿主已随宿主升级运行于 rc.1（2026-11-04 实机验收：市场面板、设置通路与全量客户端产物下发均正常） |

dsh-m README · 兼容与常见问题：> 表中各代核验对应其时点的 dsh-m 版本：0.10.x 线的完整实测仅覆盖 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3，0.11.x 线覆盖 0.2.1-rc.4（rc.5 为契约面等价重发布，核验结论按等价口径外推），0.12.x 线覆盖 0.2.2-rc.1（2026-11-04 起）；更老代际未经当前版本复测，不代表当前 dsh-m 可在其上运行。

**Desktop 与 Web 完全一样吗？** 不是。Desktop 的浏览、安装新包和开关作用于 desktop profile；升级/卸载等操作需宿主官方 `pluginManager` 提供相应能力，缺失时返回结构化拒绝和指引。Desktop 不提供 Web 的一键重启；变更需按应用提示退出并重新打开。两边的收藏、操作记录和已装状态互不串联。

dsh-m README · 兼容与常见问题：**安装、更新后何时生效？** Web 按操作返回的激活要求处理：仅客户端更新可刷新页面；需要重启时先征得同意，再由宿主完成重启与后台重连。重启优先交还服务管理器按其 Restart 策略自动拉起；systemd 部署建议配置 `Restart=on-failure` 或 `Restart=always`，其余部署按各自方式重启。

**为什么 GitHub 插件的更新不跟踪 `main`？** 中间提交可能不稳定，dsh-m 跟踪 release / tag，并锁定其 commit SHA。匿名 GitHub 配额有限，未完成的检查会如实显示，不冒充「全部最新」。

**自定义清单不可用怎么办？** 优先使用该源上次成功的缓存；没有缓存时会提示清单不可用，已装管理仍能工作。修正地址或在设置页恢复默认即可。

text: dsh-m README · Quick start：In DSH's official **Plugin Manager → Add plugin**, enter `dsh-m`, select an installation source reachable from your network, and install. **Restart DSH Web and refresh the page; on Desktop, quit and reopen the app.** Open “Plugin Marketplace” at the bottom of the sidebar.

dsh-m README · Quick start：On a headless Web host, you can also run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-m`. Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19.0; see the [compatibility table](#compatibility--faq). `npm install -g dsh-m` installs **only the standalone `dshm` CLI**, not the marketplace plugin in a DSH profile.

dsh-m README · Quick start：> In-place update support in the official plugin manager depends on the host version. If it explicitly says updates are unsupported, follow its guidance to uninstall the old version and install the new one. Uninstall does not silently erase plugin data.

dsh-m README · Browse, search, install：- **Community + Curated**: the community directory is on by default, with 6,000+ listings (grows with the upstream catalog; the panel shows the live count). Curated picks are organized into Essentials / Cui Picks / iasi Self-dev / Tencent Lighthouse / Watchlist. Curated wins for same-name entries: cross-catalog search shows only the curated version, while Community browsing keeps such entries marked with a "Curated" badge.
- **Zoned browsing, global search**: each zone remembers its own category, sort (the Community zone sorts by downloads / stars / date added), and pagination. A Chinese or English query searches both catalogs and shows their separate hit counts. Favorites live in browser localStorage — they are not part of the profile or the server.
- **Inspect before installing**: cards show origin, installation status, and version; icons prefer the declared catalog/package icon and fall back to the GitHub avatar. Details show the description, compatibility information, and installation entry point. Badges like "Author's own" and "Version-independent" are audience/adaptation hints, not security or quality endorsements. npm installs pin an **

|---|---|

> **Community listing is not a security review.** With 6,000+ entries from varied sources, inspect the author, code, and requested capabilities before installing. Missing capability data means “not scanned,” **not** “no risks found.”

dsh-m README · Installed plugins & settings：**Installed** reflects the current host profile's actual packages: marketplace/non-marketplace origin, runtime phase, available updates, toggles, upgrades, "Update all", and confirmed uninstall — batch updates run serially, stop at the first real failure, and always upgrade dsh-m itself last. Operation progress and results are tracked together. A toggle may apply live or require a restart; follow the returned result. Uninstall removes the package reference without silently deleting user data and reports possible leftover paths separately.

dsh-m README · Installed plugins & settings：**Settings** shows the community catalog's version, fetch route, and cache state, and lets you disable or pin its version. You can download the default curated registry, provide a custom address, and **validate before replacing the Curated zone as a whole** (the Community zone is unaffected). Failed validation preserves the active configuration; successful apply and restore-default are live, without a restart.

dsh-m README · Installed plugins & settings：A custom registry may come from HTTPS, a local absolute path, or `file://` (HTTP is for loopback debugging only); limits are 2 MiB and 1,000 entries. A custom source is an independent snapshot and **does not sync automatically** with the default curated registry. If it fails, its own last good cache remains in use; dsh-m never silently switches back to the default. See the [registry copy guide](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/registry-copy-guide.md) and [design document](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md) for the full rules.

dsh-m README · Agent tools & CLI：The GUI and Agent tools manage the **current host profile** (Web or Desktop). The standalone CLI, by contrast, targets the web profile; the only exception is the read-only `dshm doctor --profile desktop` health check — other commands reject `--profile desktop`, and Desktop plugin management goes through the official plugin page. `--force` may be used with install/upgrade after the user accepts a peer-compatibility risk. If the catalog is unavailable, `registry`, `search`, and `outdated` fail explicitly while `list` still lists installed packages. See the [design document](https://github.com/iasiv5/dsh-m/blob/main/docs/DESIGN.md) for full parameters and runtime policy.

dsh-m README · Compatibility & FAQ：> Each generation's verification reflects the dsh-m of its era: the 0.10.x line is fully verified only against DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3, the 0.11.x line against 0.2.1-rc.4 (rc.5 is a contract-surface equivalent re-release; conclusions carry over by equivalence), and the 0.12.x line against 0.2.2-rc.1 (since 2026-11-04). Older generations have not been re-tested with the current version and are not a claim that current dsh-m runs on them.

dsh-m README · Compatibility & FAQ：**Is Desktop identical to Web?** No. Desktop browsing, new-package installation, and toggles act on the desktop profile. Upgrades and uninstalls require capabilities from the official host `pluginManager`; if absent, dsh-m returns a structured refusal and guidance. Desktop uses the official app lifecycle rather than Web's one-click restart; quit and reopen as instructed. Favorites, operations, and installed states are separate between profiles.

dsh-m README · Compatibility & FAQ：**When do installs or updates take effect?** On Web, follow the activation result: a client-only update needs a refresh; operations marked restart-required need consent before the host restarts, followed by background reconnection. Restarts hand control back to the service manager, which restarts per its Restart policy; systemd deployments should configure `Restart=on-failure` or `Restart=always`, and other deployments use their own restart method.

dsh-m README · Compatibility & FAQ：**Why don't GitHub updates follow `main`?** Intermediate commits may be unstable. dsh-m tracks releases/tags and pins their commit SHAs. Because anonymous GitHub API quota is limited, an incomplete passive check is labeled as such rather than “all up to date.”

**What if my custom registry goes down?** Its last successful cache is used first. Without any cache, the registry is reported unavailable while installed plugins remain manageable. Fix the address or restore the default in Settings.
